title: Calibration Wave 2
mission: Execute recalibration batch for items upgraded in S853 (Analyze) and S854 (Evaluate). ≤28 items per governance rules.

scope.rationale: Priority given to Evaluate items (3) and label-score mismatches (3). Remaining 19 Analyze items have adequate calibrations or need only minor label adjustments for a follow-up wave.

recalibrations_applied.rationale: Evaluate-level incident response prioritization — requires weighing 4 competing priorities. Difficult(4) warranted.
Label-score mismatch fixed. Difficulty label already 'Difficult' but score was 2. Score aligned to 4.
Label-score mismatch AND understated. Genuine Evaluate data quality judgment. Both label and score upgraded.
Label-score mismatch fixed. Overstated 'Difficult' for straightforward control classification. Moderate(3).
Label-score mismatch. Score was already 1 (Easy) but label said Moderate-Easy. Label aligned downward.
Overstated for definition-match item. Downgrade to Easy(1).

key_observations: 7 of 25 items (28%) have Difficulty label vs. DifficultyScore mismatches — systemic template artifact
9 of 22 'Analyze' items (41%) are definition-match questions mislabeled as Analyze — these were upgraded via CognitiveLevel change without difficulty reassessment
3 of 3 Evaluate items were understated — all upgraded to Difficult(4)
The S853/S854 cognitive upgrades did not trigger corresponding difficulty recalibration — 25 items retained pre-upgrade labels

distribution_analysis.movement_toward_targets: 3 Evaluate items moved to Difficult(4). 2 overstated items downgraded. Movement is toward CAQS §6.1 target distribution but significant calibration work remains for the broader 2,500-item pool.

deferred_items: 11 Pack C Analyze items — need individual Difficulty review
5 Pack D Analyze items — ED-001, ED-010, ED-016, ED-025, ED-028, ED-035, ED-046 — adequately calibrated or marginal

revisionHistory.summary: Calibration Wave 2: 6 items recalibrated (3 Evaluate → Difficult, 1 overstated → Moderate, 2 overstated → Easy). 14 items identified as needing recalibration; 6 prioritized for the 28-item batch cap. Difficulty distribution analysis shows movement toward CAQS targets.
